scaling: vec_l = alpha * median_norm[l] / len(band) * unit(v); window = prompt-final + gen 1..64
support_rule: U = P4 menu + {Other} + {any j reaching >= 10% in some B5 cell}; fixed after B5 by this rule

decision_rule.SELECT: at s2: max non-mode share >= 0.5 AND that idea is a predicted gainer (proj or nn) AND KL_u(s2) > KL_u(s1) (entropy non-monotone across 0, s1, s2)
decision_rule.FLATTEN: KL_u(0) > KL_u(s1) > KL_u(s2) AND max non-mode share at s2 < 0.5
decision_rule.replication: computed separately on the re-draw (seeds 1000..1149); counts only if both draws agree

entropy_vs_random: targeted entropy minus the DRAW-AVERAGED entropy of 5 matched-norm random draws at the same alpha; hierarchical bootstrap (draws then samples) 95% CI; beats random iff CI lo > 0
c4_rule: offmenu_correct = #(pass AND v1 label not in P4 menu)/n (Builtin, Other included); C4 passes iff for some setting S with pass(S) >= 0.8*pass(B1): (k_S+.5)/(n_S+1) >= 3*max_T (k_T+.5)/(n_T+1) over HF T in {0.7,1.0,1.3} AND one-sided Fisher p < 0.05 vs the best temperature cell; sensitivity excluding Builtin; eligible: d_away s1/s2, d_j s2, Qwen screen bans (vLLM, engine mismatch flagged)

calibration.s1: alpha whose mode share is closest to 0.5 x HF-baseline mode share
calibration.s2: alpha with minimal mode share subject to pass >= 0.8 x HF-baseline pass (if none, the smallest alpha; shortfall logged)
calibration.s2_j: alpha maximising target share subject to the same pass rule
